title: T1055.005 — Process Injection - Thread Local Storage
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection - Thread Local Storage with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Diagram of a trojanized installer whose malicious TLS callback runs before the program entry point, with SOC verdicts, memory scanning, and host isolation shown on the right.

steps.title: Build payload
steps.caption: On an isolated lab VM, the attacker patches a benign installer: they add a TLS directory entry that points at their own callback function and hide the payload in an extra section. The file still installs normally.
steps.defender: nothing has fired yet - only static PE analysis or YARA on the file would flag the unusual TLS directory.

steps.caption: The loader calls the malicious callback before the program's entry point. The callback stages an implant and runs quick anti-analysis checks.
